messages:
Marco (PartnerEng): Heads-up — we're planning a breaking auth header change: deprecate X-Redwood-Auth in favor of standard Authorization: Bearer <token>. Targeting a 90-day graceful window. Need partner + marketplace coordination. :wave:
Priya (SDK): Noted. We'll ship client-side fallback in the next minor so apps keep working during transition. Will open PRs for js/py/go today.
Alice (PM): Can we run a 2-week canary with top 10 partners before announcing? Want to avoid noisy support tickets.
Marco (PartnerEng): Yes. Proposed plan: 1) canary w/ partners flagged as low-risk 2) publish migration guide + code shims 3) 90-day deprecation notices 4) auto-redirect fallback in gateway for 180 days. Thoughts?
Sam (Solutions): Please include checklist for Marketplace vendors — packaging, marketplace UI notes, and partner-facing sample emails. I can draft the vendor comms template.
Priya (SDK): For shims, approach is small intercept in SDK request path. Example patch (JS):
```js
// shim: keep supporting X-Redwood-Auth until deprecation window closes
if (headers['authorization']) { headers['Authorization'] = headers['authorization']; }
else if (headers['X-Redwood-Auth']) { headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${headers['X-Redwood-Auth']}`; }
```
We'll mark as opt-in behind feature flag initially.
Liam (Legal): Check export controls and logging — changing header surface could affect downstream proxies. Add a note about PII in headers and ensure logs scrub tokens.
Marco (PartnerEng): Good call. We'll add logging guidance and KMS/HSM note for Private customers.
Priya (SDK): Semver plan: ship as minor (v2.x -> v2.x+1) with deprecation warning in console. We'll include opt-out env var for partners who want explicit failure.
Sam (Solutions): For hardware SI partners, we need a compatibility matrix: firmware versions that proxy headers unchanged vs. those that rewrite. I'll ping the HW SIs.
Marco (PartnerEng): Can partners consume a temporary compatibility endpoint? e.g., https://api.redwood.example/v1/compat that accepts both headers and returns Migration-Status header. Could help integrators detect clients to nudge.
Alice (PM): Love that. Add telemetry for percent trafic still using X-Redwood-Auth. We can surface that in Console per-partner usage.
Priya (SDK): I'll add deprecation warnings to SDK logs and emit a telemetry event when legacy header seen.
Marco (PartnerEng): Timeline: week 0 canary, week 2 expand to beta partners, week 6 public announce + 90-day deprecation window start. Need partner list by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Solutions): I'll compile vendor list and highlight marketplace packages that must be updated.
Liam (Legal): Also confirm the wording of public notice — we should avoid "breaking" in customer-facing subject lines. Use "auth header update" + clear rollback instructions.
deploy-bot: Canary task queued: canary-auth-header-toggle -> job/ci-5691 started (will post results to #eng-releases).
Marco (PartnerEng): Thanks — I'll start the partner outreach doc and link it here when ready. Ping me @Priya @Sam if you need specific vendor contacts. :thumbsup:
